title: Account Executive - PR & Communications
description:

title: Mid-Market Account Executive
description:

title: Mid-Market Account Executive

title: Account Executive, Mid-Market
description:
About Sundial

Sundial is the scheduling and staffing platform used by more than 9,000 clinics, salons, fitness studios and service businesses to fill their calendars and keep their teams in sync. We started as a two-person side project and are now a fully remote team of 240 people across 31 US states. In 2025 we were named one of the fastest-growing private software companies in the Midwest, and our net revenue retention sits above 120%.

Why people stay

  • Remote-first since day one, with a home-office stipend of $1,200 and a monthly $100 wellness allowance
  • Two company-wide offsites a year, most recently in Denver and Savannah
  • Unlimited PTO with a 15-day minimum we actually enforce
  • Medical, dental and vision from your first day, plus a 4% 401(k) match

What you will do

  • Close new business with multi-location operators of 50 to 1,500 employees
  • Run discovery, demos and pricing conversations with owners, COOs and finance leads
  • Work alongside a dedicated SDR and a solutions consultant
  • Keep pipeline and forecast current in Salesforce

What you bring

  • 3-6 years as an account executive in B2B SaaS
  • Consistent quota attainment you can talk us through
  • Experience with deal cycles of 30-120 days and multiple stakeholders
  • US residency; we hire in any US state

title: Account Executive - Freight Solutions

title: Account Executive
description:
Every year, mid-sized companies lose millions of dollars to off-contract spending, duplicate suppliers and invoices that nobody can trace back to a purchase order. Tidemark exists to fix that. Our spend-management platform gives finance teams a single place to request, approve and pay for everything their business buys, and our customers save on average 7% of addressable spend in their first year.

We are a Series C company backed by long-term investors, headquartered in the Fulton Market district of Chicago with smaller hubs in Atlanta and Phoenix. We are 310 people strong, and we care a lot about how we work: written decisions, honest feedback and no meetings on Friday afternoons. Our benefits include fully paid health coverage, a $2,000 annual wellbeing budget, commuter benefits, catered lunches three days a week, and equity for every employee.

The team: our North America sales organisation has grown from 9 to 34 account executives in two years, and more than half of our sales managers were promoted from within.

The role: you will carry a new-business quota for companies with 250 to 2,500 employees in the Central region, selling to CFOs, controllers and procurement leaders. Expect deals in the $40k-$150k ACV range and cycles of three to five months.

Requirements:
* 4+ years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS
* Consistent over-attainment against quota
* Experience selling to finance or operations buyers
* Salesforce proficiency and strong forecasting habits
* Ability to work from our Chicago office at least three days per week

title: Account Executive (Mid-Market)

title: Mid-Market Account Executive
description:
Harborlight Software builds the operating system for independent property managers. More than 4,000 property management firms across North America use Harborlight to collect rent, run maintenance requests, screen tenants and close their books every month. We were founded in Chicago in 2016, we are profitable, and we grew ARR 58% last year without a single round of layoffs. Our customers tell us we gave them their evenings back, and that is the outcome we care about most.

Life at Harborlight: we work from our River North office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays and from wherever you like the rest of the week. We cover 100% of medical, dental and vision premiums for employees and 80% for dependents, offer 16 weeks of paid parental leave for every parent, match 401(k) contributions up to 4%, and give every employee a $1,500 annual learning budget. We close the whole company between Christmas and New Year.

The role
As a Mid-Market Account Executive you will own new-logo revenue from property management companies with 2,000 to 20,000 units under management. You will run the full cycle: discovery, tailored demos, business cases with owners and CFOs, security questionnaires and contract negotiation. Deals typically land between $30k and $110k ACV with 60-90 day cycles.

What we are looking for
- 3+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally selling to mid-market buyers
- A documented record of meeting or beating annual quota
- Daily use of Salesforce and disciplined forecasting
- Comfort multi-threading across operations, finance and IT
- Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar qualification framework is a plus
